description:
Buy-and-hold return for an asset between two dates, as a percentage. Use it whenever you state what a strategy returned: a return with nothing to compare it against does not answer whether the strategy was worth running. run_backtest already includes this for its own window, so call this for a different asset or a different period. A YYYY-MM-DD end date includes that completed UTC day; an exact end timestamp is passed through without adding a day.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

asset.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

base_token.description: Canonical base token; supply with quote_token and market_data_venue.

market_data_venue.description: Exact venue of the requested market.

quote_token.description: Quote currency of the requested market.

start_date.description: ISO start of the window, e.g. 2026-01-01.

name: get_benchmark
